# Getting help

| You have | Go to |
| --- | --- |
| a question about how to run something | [the guides](../docs/README.md), then an issue with the "question" label |
| a command that failed | the "bug report" issue form |
| a missing or wrong act, field or file | the "problem with data" issue form |
| an idea, or a new Polish public source | the "feature request" or "new source" issue form |
| a security problem or a leaked token | [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md), privately |

Polish and English are both welcome.

This project cannot answer questions about the law itself. It gathers the
published acts and does not interpret them. For a legal problem, ask a
lawyer; free legal aid in Poland is described at
[np.ms.gov.pl](https://np.ms.gov.pl).
